$comment: SM030 O3: replaces platform_evidence_standard (deprecated, kept for history). One row per obligation - the flat shelf-fact projection of one instrument's obligations/*.yaml entry (obligation.schema.json / instrument.schema.json), plus the engine-routing fields (`kind`, `register`, `register_match`) a verdict recompute needs to evaluate it against a project's own registers. Those three are NOT published in the obligations/ tree: they are Demiton's own wiring for which register feeds which check, not part of what the obligation is (GOVERNANCE.md's public/private line).

instrument_id.description: the instrument this obligation belongs to, e.g. `bif_act_2017_qld`

instrument_title.description: the instrument's title, for display without a second lookup

source.description: which of the seven sources the instrument belongs to

consequence.description: what missing the duty costs, as the source states it

protection_type.description: the engine that runs this obligation once switched on

disease.description: which of the five diseases this obligation guards against

grade.description: how close to the primary source the reading was

citation_url.description: the primary source for this exact duty

citation_clause.description: the citation's own clause reference, when it differs from `clause`

citation_access_date.description: when the primary source was read

evidence_kind.description: how this obligation is evidenced once switched on

evidence_system_type.description: for evidence_kind=register only: the system type that would fill it

jurisdiction.description: where this obligation applies: the ISO 3166-1/3166-2 code

applies_to_form.description: the contract form this obligation is written for; `statute` for a legislative rule, `any` when form-independent

kind.description: ENGINE ROUTING, not published: how the duty is measured against a project's registers - a cadence (`periodic`), a window after an anchor event (`event_bound`), a retention period (`retention`) or a standing condition (`state`)

register.description: ENGINE ROUTING, not published: the tenant register this obligation is evaluated against

register_match.description: ENGINE ROUTING, not published: equality predicate on `register` selecting the evidence

window_value.description: the cadence or window length in `window_unit`

research_row.description: the row id in Demiton's own research record this obligation was transcribed from

title: platform_obligation contract v1
